title: Urban Oasis by Missoni — Business Bay, Dubai Canal
raw_content:
Urban Oasis by Missoni

Located on the Dubai Canal in Business Bay, Urban Oasis is a 34-storey residential development co-branded with the renowned Italian fashion house Missoni.

Featuring bespoke interior decor, iconic Missoni zigzag patterns, and luxury furnishings, the development offers studios, 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments and penthouses.

Amenities and Lifestyle:

  • Direct waterfront canal promenade access
  • Infinity swimming pool overlooking the canal and Downtown Dubai skyline
  • State-of-the-art gym and wellness spa
  • Concierge and valet parking services
  • Strategic location: 5 minutes from Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa, 7 minutes from Jumeirah Beach
